name: The Common Mallard
text: The primary denizen of our valley. They fly faster as the hunter's skill improves. Every 10 rounds, they migrate as the seasons shift from Spring to Winter.

name: Golden Tiger
text: A rare predator that only descends from elite Level 4 ducks. Extremely fast and dangerous. Bringing one down is a feat of legendary skill and yields high rewards.

name: Sky Banner
text: A metal bird from the world beyond. It flys across the heavens carrying wordly banners. Hit it to reclaim some of its treasures.

name: Heavy Bomber
text: A shadow of war that arrives randomly. Strike it down to clear the skies of lesser avian threats, or face the consequences if it escapes your reach.

name: The Cynical Retriever
text: Your faithful yet judgmental companion. He mocks your failures with a snicker and celebrates your success with a jingle, reminding us all of the futility of the hunt.

name: The Shadowy Figure
text: A mysterious monk who offers wisdom and insults in equal measure. He dwells in the deeper layers of the reality, watching the hunter's every move.
